groups.label: Suggestions are wrong or invented
groups.definition: Suggested code looks plausible but is wrong, or refers to APIs or flags that do not exist.
groups.include: Subtle bugs, invented methods or flags, careless output.
groups.exclude: Time spent checking goes to 'Checking and fixing output costs time'.

groups.label: Checking and fixing output costs time
groups.definition: Reviewing, editing or chasing the assistant's output takes time, sometimes more than it saves.
groups.include: Review time, heavy editing, chasing errors, extra review steps.
groups.exclude: The errors themselves go to 'Suggestions are wrong or invented'.
groups.rationale: R07 and R23 in all three.

groups.label: Security, licensing and data risks
groups.definition: The developer sees risks to security, licensing or data handling.
groups.include: Insecure suggestions, licence worries, unclear data flows to the vendor.
groups.exclude: Rules that restrict use go to 'Organisation restricts where it may be used'.
groups.rationale: R04, R11, R18 in all three.

groups.label: Organisation restricts where it may be used
groups.definition: A lead, legal team or policy limits where the assistant may be used, or leaves it unclear.
groups.exclude: Risks without a rule go to 'Security, licensing and data risks'.

groups.label: Does not fit team conventions or internal libraries
groups.definition: Generated code ignores the team's conventions or does not fit its internal libraries.
groups.include: Naming conventions, internal libraries, house style.
groups.exclude: Plainly wrong code goes to 'Suggestions are wrong or invented'.
groups.rationale: R08 and R25 in all three.

groups.label: Reliance without understanding and loss of skills
groups.definition: Developers may accept suggestions without understanding them or lose their own skills.
groups.include: Juniors accepting suggestions, fear of deskilling, needing to supervise it.
groups.exclude: Wrong output itself goes to 'Suggestions are wrong or invented'.
groups.rationale: R09 and R27 shared across all three.
